program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
closed_component: Close only the internal process-boundary component: incorrect-amount PLTSS post-payment reviews can result in bills of collection.
decision_basis: The component gate narrow candidate and upstream VA boundary-readiness row support the bills-of-collection process boundary while explicitly excluding recoverable-dollar scoring.
excluded_scope: Does not close recoverable subset, collectible amount, recoverability rate, savings estimate, avoided outlay, PLTSS field closure, or any scoring gate.
residual_open_need: Recoverable incorrect-amount subset and collectible-dollar basis remain open before any waste-reduction score or public claim.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate narrow decision only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
